newsitem.title: USA: Richland Cty, S.C., approves two school GO bonds.
newsitem.headline: Richland Cty, S.C., approves two school GO bonds.

text.p: Voters in South Carolina's Richland County School Districts 1 and 2 approved a pair of general obligation bond issues for schools in weekend voting, county election officials said Monday.
District 1 voters approved a $184 million school bond issue with 9,530 yes votes, or 58.7 percent, and 6,714 no votes or 41.3 percent, in Saturday's referendum.
The bonds would finance a middle school, seven elementary schools, and renovation, computers and electrical wiring upgrades at existing schools.
District 2 voters approved a $19.7 million school bond issue with 2,581 yes votes, or 63.2 percent, and 1,504 no votes, or 36.8 percent.
Both districts are in the urban Columbia area.
